attestations.text: Ch'ien Jui-chêng 錢瑞徵 (T. 鶴庵, 1620–1702, chü-jên of 1663), at Ch'ü-chou, Chekiang, where the latter served as director of the district school (1686-97). She managed the affairs of her family with vigor and understanding and sometimes solved difficult problems relating to her husband's clan.
